info.title: MICROSERVICE-apiwizruntimedoc-List Events Ticketing Tickets Validates-v3-spec
info.description: The Event Ticket Validation API enables consumers to verify the validity of tickets for events. By providing ticket details, users can ensure that their tickets are valid for admission. This API is particularly useful for event organizers, ticket vendors, and end-users who need assurance before attending an event. It supports seamless integration with ticketing systems, enhancing customer trust and preventing ticket fraud. Utilize this API to maintain an efficient and secure ticketing process.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to validate a purchased ticket to ensure its authenticity and usability. This is vital for guaranteeing that the ticket is valid for entry.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to validate ticket details before proceeding with further operations. It should include all necessary parameters related to the ticket, ensuring that the validation process can be effectively performed.

200.description: The validation request was processed successfully.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesReque.description: A placeholder for the request body of the GET operation related to ticket validation. This string should contain the necessary validation details.

status.description: Indicates whether the operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: Unique reference number associated with the ticket.

resultId.description: Identifier for the result of the ticket validation.

state.description: Current state of the ticket validation process.

processingTimeMs.description: Time taken to process the request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional information about the response.

audit.description: Audit information related to the ticket validation process.

ListEventsTicketingTicketsValidatesRespo.description: Schema representing the successful response for the ticket validation operation.

createdBy.description: Identifier of the user who created the entry.

createdAt.description: Timestamp indicating when the entry was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the process was automated or manual.

Audit.description: Schema representing audit information about the ticket validation process.
